renewal_condition: No affirmative election required; renewal is automatic for consecutive 24-month periods unless either party gives written non-renewal notice at least 18 months prior to expiration of the then-current Term.
notice_period: At least 18 (eighteen) months prior to the expiration of the then-current Term; either party to the other; purpose: non-renewal to prevent automatic 24-month extension.
deadline_reason: The right is fixed, not rolling: the clause states notice must be given 'at least 18 (eighteen) months prior to the expiration of the then-current Term' with no 'at any time' language. The Initial Term end date is expressly stated as April 1, 2027. The non-renewal deadline for the Initial Term is therefore 18 months before April 1, 2027. Subsequent deadlines recur 18 months before each 24-month renewal expiry. Both the term-end date and the notice rule are established by the contract, so the deadline is calculable (though this system is instructed not to compute the calendar date itself).
